name: Chub AI
summary: A character-card library and roleplay front end that connects to the provider stack you choose — its own Mars models, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, NovelAI, or your own local hardware.
ranking_rationale: Official docs verify the uncensored positioning, the Imagine image feature, chat-memory summaries, text-to-speech, and wide model/API portability. Subscription page could not be fetched fresh and prices could not be verified, so it ranks on documented flexibility — not price.
